explanation: The two-job execution contains a fault because upstream provenance cannot be used downstream to preserve upstream order. Job 1's assemble_provenance constructs evidence_sources with record_id set to the source_id rather than the demand record_id, producing handoff rows such as record_id s01 instead of n06-r01. Job 2 then looks up upstream ranks by coverage record_id, so every observed priority has upstream_rank 0. The downstream ranking is a consequence of the malformed upstream handoff, not a supported downstream localization fault.
cited_evidence: Behavioural criteria require preserving record_id/source provenance and ranking unsupported needs first while preserving upstream provenance order.
Job 1 source assemble_provenance appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': ..., 'rank': index}.
Observed Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while needs and coverage use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Job 2 prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources['record_id'] and looks it up using coverage['record_id']; observed priorities consequently all have upstream_rank: 0.
